contexts.text: It is charity itself which fashions the form and is itself fashioned in it... HH 414.
Every regenerate man is... an effigy or image of the universal Heaven.
Their likeness was shown me. Described.
The spiritual things of will and thought are correspondentially effigiated in natural acts.
Man was created and formed in the likeness of the three Heavens.
The soul or spirit is the very effigy of the man; whereas the body is his representative image. When a man rises again... he is in his internal, or in his likeness itself.
For the image vanishes when the likeness itself appears.
Man is exactly such as is the end with him, and his effigy is such in the light of Heaven... Such as is his effigy in general, such is the effigy of the least things of his will.
That their falsifiers fashioned the like. Signified.
The face is formed to effigiate what the man thinks and wills.
The representative disappears when the likeness itself appears.
They changed their glory into the effigy of an ox that eateth grass ()... The effigy of an ox = a semblance of good in the external form...
The internal man effigy.
Man was made... Heaven in the least effigy.
The whole Heaven... is a Divine spiritual man... even in effigy...
The upright Spirits... said... that they are not minds without form... but that they are men in effigy...
The body is the effigy of the mind...
All things that have been done and thought... appear... as if seen in effigy...
Everyone is the likeness of his own love... HH 498. LJ 30.
An evil man who in externals assumes the semblance of a good man...
A Spirit... is in an external form which is the type or effigy of his internals.
Spiritual things are there effigiated in their complete image in an appearance as it were natural...
The universal Heaven is in this effigy, because God is a Man.
Two (such) married partners, are the effigy and form of that love.
I saw... spectres in various shapes.
The spiritual region of the human mind is a Heaven in the least form; and the natural region is a world in the least form.
Thus the Lord dispersed figures, and revealed the very forms...
They represented to me the character of the likeness of those who...
The face is the effigy of the interiors...
Gestures by which he effigiates the affections...
Angelic Idea of Creation. The ancients effigiated the Divine proceeding by golden circles...
